description: Aree stradali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tms.comune.fi.it. Polygonal elements representing the public road areas of the Municipality of Florence, organized by road trunks and intersections. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Road areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include strade, toponomastica, mobilità, aree stradali, open data. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
